proposals_applied_this_week.reasoning: All 6 missed signals were blocked by this gate. A threshold of 6.0% was designed for post-results momentum stocks; it is structurally too high for the broader Nifty 500 universe where a 3% single-day move already represents meaningful supply accumulation. proposals_applied_this_week.expected_impact: Unblocks approximately 2 of the 6 missed signals directly. Increases signal frequency; the existing impulse-candle and turnover gates remain as quality filters so raw win rate should not degrade materially.

proposals_applied_this_week.reasoning: Momentum Breakout Bullish has 2 wins, 2 losses, 4 expired across 8 signals — 25% win rate. This is the best-performing panel in the dataset but still only 25%. The confirmation candle gate (MB_CONFIRM_MAX_RANGE_PCT) is the panel's primary quality filter for 'calm absorption after the break'. At 0.35% range, a candle on a Rs 500 stock can be Rs 1.75 wide — still a meaningful indecision candle. Tightening to 0.25% enforces a genuinely narrow, absorbed confirmation. The 2 losses likely include cases where the confirm candle was wide enough to indicate two-way interest rather than one-sided continuation. This is the one parameter in Momentum Breakout that directly filters signal quality rather than just presence-of-signal. The change from 0.35 to 0.25 is a 29% tightening — meaningful but not extreme.

Expected to improve win rate above 25% by removing marginal setups. The 4 expired signals are a secondary concern — tighter confirmation does not directly address time-in-session, but cleaner setups tend to move faster post-entry.

structural_proposals.title: Add intraday gap-up OR earnings-spike as an alternative exhaustion trigger, replacing the sole reliance on prev_day_rally
structural_proposals.proposed_change: Introduce a fourth 'had_spike_open' condition alongside had_rally, had_cumul, and had_gap_up. Define: had_spike_open = (today_open_early > daily['High'].iloc[-2]) AND (gap_up_pct >= EXH_GAP_UP_PCT). The existing gate is: 'if not (had_rally or had_cumul or had_gap_up): continue'. Extend it to: 'if not (had_rally or had_cumul or had_gap_up or had_spike_open): continue'. Also independently lower EXH_PREV_DAY_RALLY_PCT (handled in parameter_tune proposal below) so that moderate prior-day moves like VOLTAS at 2.4% are not flatly excluded. had_spike_open captures cases where a stock gaps above its own PDH on open — already a structural supply zone — even when the prior close-to-close move was flat or negative (DMART: 0.23%, GODREJIND: -0.19%, BATAINDIA: -1.29%). Suggested new constant: EXH_GAP_ABOVE_PDH = True (boolean flag enabling this path). Place this logic immediately after the existing had_gap_up assignment, before the combined OR check.
structural_proposals.reasoning: All 6 missed signals were blocked by prev_day_rally. Three of the five shown samples (DMART 0.23%, GODREJIND -0.19%, BATAINDIA -1.29%) had essentially flat or down prior days yet still produced 5-7% intraday falls from the high — the defining characteristic in each case was a gap-up open above PDH creating an immediate supply cluster, not a multi-day rally. The current logic has no path for this condition at all. VOLTAS at 2.4% and CROMPTON at 1.47% also failed the 6.0% threshold despite being genuine exhaustion moves.
structural_proposals.expected_impact: Captures 3-4 of the 6 missed signals that opened above PDH with no meaningful prior-day rally. Minor increase in false positives possible on news-driven gap-ups that continue higher — mitigated by the existing spike-candle turnover and Bollinger band gates which must still pass.

structural_proposals.panel: Bear Trap Reversal / Bull Trap Reversal
structural_proposals.title: Add a session-time gate: suppress signals generated after 13:00 IST when T1/T2 are unlikely to be reached before 15:30
structural_proposals.proposed_change: Add a time-of-day check at the top of _screen_trap(), analogous to the Exhaustion Short window check. Introduce constant: TRAP_LATEST_ENTRY_TIME = time(13, 0). At the start of the function (before the universe loop), check: if datetime.now(ist).time() > TRAP_LATEST_ENTRY_TIME: return []. Additionally, within the loop, after computing t1 and t2 but before appending results, compute minutes_remaining = (datetime.combine(today_date, time(15, 20)) - datetime.now(ist).replace(tzinfo=None)).total_seconds() / 60 and skip any result where minutes_remaining < risk / current_price * 100 * 10 (a rough proxy: if the SL is 1% wide, you need at least 10 minutes of runway minimum — tune the multiplier as TRAP_MIN_RUNWAY_MINUTES = 45). Place this check immediately before the results.append() call.
structural_proposals.reasoning: Bear Trap has 8 signals total: 0 wins, 0 losses, 8 expired. Bull Trap has 6 signals: 0 wins, 1 loss, 5 expired. The 'expired' category dominates both panels — signals that neither hit T1 nor SL before market close. This is a timing problem, not a gate-quality problem. A trap reversal by definition fires mid-session (after the trap bar and then the reversal bar, which requires at minimum 2-3 bars = 10-15 minutes into the session, often later). Signals firing at 13:30-14:30 with a 1.5R target have insufficient time to reach T1 before 15:30, so they expire. The current code has no time-of-day check for Trap panels at all.
structural_proposals.expected_impact: Reduces total signal count for both Trap panels, but eliminates the dominant 'expired' outcome. Remaining signals will have adequate session time to resolve. Win rate percentage should improve as expired signals (which have zero win contribution) are suppressed.

structural_proposals.title: Require Nifty to be down on the day (not just not strongly up) before firing a bearish breakdown signal
structural_proposals.proposed_change: The current code checks 'if nifty_chg > 1.0: continue' for bearish direction — only filtering out a strongly bullish Nifty. Change the threshold to a new constant: MB_NIFTY_BEARISH_MAX_PCT = 0.3. Apply as: 'if nifty_chg > MB_NIFTY_BEARISH_MAX_PCT: continue' for the bearish direction only. This means a bearish momentum breakdown signal will only fire when Nifty is flat-to-down on the day (change <= +0.3%), not merely 'not up more than 1%'. Place this check where the existing nifty_chg > 1.0 check sits in the bearish branch.
structural_proposals.reasoning: Momentum Breakdown Bearish shows 0 wins, 2 losses, 3 expired across 5 signals — 0% win rate. While the sample is small (caution warranted), a stock breaking PDL on a day when Nifty is rising +0.5% to +0.9% is fighting the broad tape. The current gate of +1.0% is too permissive for a pure trend-following breakdown — a stock that breaks down while the index is up 0.6% has a structurally lower probability of follow-through than one breaking down when the index is flat or negative. This is a directional alignment issue not a gate-threshold issue.
structural_proposals.expected_impact: Reduces bearish breakdown signal frequency on mixed-market days. On genuinely weak market days the signal count is unchanged. Small sample means this is a hypothesis to monitor over the next 30 days rather than a confirmed fix.

structural_proposals.title: Require the breakout candle's volume to exceed not just the day's volume minimum but also the same time-slot's historical average — ruling out thin-tape false breakouts
structural_proposals.proposed_change: After the existing day_vol >= PDH_VOL_MIN check, add a same-slot volume check using the 15-min batch (already loaded as batch_15m / intra). For the bar at index bos_bar in today_bars, retrieve its timestamp, then look back across the prior 3 sessions for bars at the same HH:MM slot. Compute avg_same_slot_vol_15m = mean of those prior-session volumes. Require that today_bars['Volume'].iloc[bos_bar] >= avg_same_slot_vol_15m * PDH_BREAKOUT_SLOT_VOL_MULT where PDH_BREAKOUT_SLOT_VOL_MULT = 1.2. If fewer than 2 prior-session same-slot bars are available, skip this check (data guard). Insert this gate immediately after the PDH_VOL_MIN check, before the VWAP check. This mirrors the same-slot logic already proven in Exhaustion Short.
structural_proposals.reasoning: PDH Breakout has 0 wins, 1 loss, 1 expired across only 2 signals — 0% win rate, but the sample is too small to draw strong conclusions. The panel already passed RSI >= 60, EMA200, VWAP, ADR, and stretch filters. The most likely remaining source of false breakouts in a trend-following screen is thin-volume breakouts at atypical intraday times (e.g., a close above PDH in the 9:30 bar on unusually low volume for that time of day). The same-slot volume check is already validated in Exhaustion Short's architecture and adds specificity without requiring a new data source.
structural_proposals.expected_impact: Further reduces the already-low signal count for PDH Breakout. Quality of remaining signals should improve. Cannot confirm win-rate impact from 2 signals — treat as a hygiene improvement pending a larger sample.
